kustoQueries.title: GetAllStorageFailures
kustoQueries.kustoQuery: cluster('{{KustoCluster}}').database('process').StorageOperations |where TIMESTAMP > datetime('{{ImpactStarted}}') and accountName contains substring('{{ScaleUnit}}',11) and SourceNamespace == '{{sourceNamespace}}' and operationStatus == 'Faulted' |summarize throttled=countif(requestsDetails contains '"httpStatusCode":503'), servererror=countif(requestsDetails contains '"httpStatusCode":500'), sum(requestsTimedout) by bin(TIMESTAMP, 1m), resourceType

kustoQueries.title: GetTopStorageExceptions
kustoQueries.kustoQuery: cluster('{{KustoCluster}}').database('process').StorageOperations |where TIMESTAMP > datetime('{{ImpactStarted}}') and accountName contains substring('{{ScaleUnit}}',11) and SourceNamespace == '{{sourceNamespace}}' and operationStatus == 'Faulted' |summarize count() by exceptionMessage| order by count_ desc| take 10

kustoQueries.title: GetImpactedStorageAccounts
kustoQueries.kustoQuery: cluster('{{KustoCluster}}').database('process').StorageOperations |where TIMESTAMP > datetime('{{ImpactStarted}}') and SourceNamespace == '{{sourceNamespace}}' and operationStatus == 'Faulted' |summarize count() by accountName | order by count_ desc

incidentProcessingGuide: ### START OF INSTRUCTIONS ###
Create an EXECUTION_PLAN using the below guidelines:,
- Fetch ICM incident details and custom fields to extract Monitor Id, Region and ScaleUnit information.,
- From Impact Assessment tab, find the Monitor Id and check if the monitor Id matches '27c7f816-6097-47df-aff2-5675f536d6ed'.,
- If not, STOP and DO NOT PROCEED.,
- Taking any action after this point is a deviation from the instructions.
- Validate that the incident title does not start with [TIP].,
- If the title starts with [TIP],
- make a discussion entry 'ignoring TIP alerts'. Use exact words and do not generalize and use your own expression,
- STOP and strictly DO NOT PROCEED further.,
- Taking any action after this point is a deviation from the instructions.,
- Acknowledge the incident.,
- If enrichment discussion entries by 'RHClusterHealthImpactAndEnrichment' using get_icm_discussion_entries are not found.,
- Wait for 10 minutes to elapse since the incident was created.,
- Invoke Genevaa automation workflow 'RHClusterHealthImpactAndEnrichment' in account LogicApps on this incident.,
- If you are not able to invoke the workflow - proceed to [SG-TBD].,
- Wait for the workflow run to complete.,
- Check for enrichment discussion entries by 'RHClusterHealthImpactAndEnrichment' using get_icm_discussion_entries.,
- If such discussion entries are found.
- Make a discussion entry 'Enrichment automation has run on this incident'.,
- If enrichment entries all look blank, lack meaningful data or show errors.,

- Post a discussion entry in the incident: '**Red flag!** Monitoring/logging infrastructure issue detected. Please RA to Geneva Monitoring/Geneva Infra and Manageability team for investigation and escalation.'.,
- Then STOP and DO NOT PROCEED.,
- Review storage enrichment data in discussion entries added by 'RHClusterHealthImpactAndEnrichment'.,
- If sustained high failures/latency patterns are visible in storage data.,

- Post a discussion entry 'storage seems to be running hot. Recommend escalation to the storage team and checking the storage portal link added by the enrichment..' If trend is tapering off, document the observation.,
- If trend is tapering off, document the observation.,

- Search for other ICM incidents for owning team 'LOGICAPPS\ServicingLoop' within 30 minutes for the same region with title containing keywords like 'Job execution delay', '[InstanceHighCPU]', 'ClusterHighCPU' using search_incidents.,
- If found and region of this incident and found incident match.,
- Post a discussion entry 'found incident with title of found incident which is more specific to investigate: linking this incident as a child'.,
- Link this incident as a child of the found incident.,
- Save everything and stop processing further. If no incidents found or the found incidents do not have the same region, proceed further. ,
- The title of the incident follows the pattern '[Operational] RHClusterStatus unhealthy [Region][AppService-ScaleUnit].,
- Extract the value of Region and ScaleUnit from the title.,
- From Impact assessment tab of the incident, get the value of Impact start and we call it as ImpactStarted.,

- This is a static table lookup in the form of a kusto query and you do not need any cluster and database to run it. Run Kusto query GetsourceNamespacefromRegion using {{Region}}. remember the output as sourceNamespace and KustoCluster respectively for future queries.,
- Never infer Kusto Cluster/database names or sourceNamespace from naming conventions or patterns or from incident metadata. Stricly depend upon the mapping and lookup in the previous step.
- Even when there is no value found in the lookup for either of them, do not extrapolate and follow the listed steps below.
- In the discussion entry, look for the 'Expression CloudType. Evaluated Value'.,
- If the value is 3, then incident is on MC.,
- Assign KustoCluster value to be 'processmc.chinacloudapi.cn'.,
- If the value is 5, then incident is on FF.,
- Assign KustoCluster value to be 'processff.kusto.usgovcloudapi.net'.,
- If the sourceNamespace or KustoCluster value is empty ot null,
- Use this exact text as a discussion entry (do not paraphrase):'Looks like the {{Region}} is new, cannot find Kusto Cluster and sourceNamespace',
- After this discussion entry, strictly halt all further processing for this incident. Do not perform summaries, investigations, escalations, or any additional actions.,
- Taking any action after this point is a deviation from the instructions.
- From information purpose, print the values of {{KustoCluster}}, {{ImpactStarted}}, {{ScaleUnit}} and {{sourceNamespace}} .,

- Run Kusto query GetAllStorageFailures using KustoCluster, ImpactStarted, ScaleUnit, sourceNamespace. Add the outout of the query as discussion entry in the incident with a heading 'All storage failures;.,

- Run Kusto query GetTopStorageExceptions using KustoCluster, ImpactStarted, ScaleUnit, sourceNamespace. Add the outout of the query as discussion entry in the incident with a heading 'Top storage exceptions'.,

- Run Kusto query GetImpactedStorageAccounts using KustoCluster, ImpactStarted, sourceNamespace. Add the outout of the query as discussion entry in the incident with heading 'Impacted storage accounts, please check the storage portal for further analysis'.,

Execute the COMPLETE execution plan in a FULLY AUTONOMOUS manner, start the investigation by yourself WITHOUT printing anything like 'next steps' or 'next actions' etc, DO NOT ask for any user confirmation or input.,
Post a final discussion entry with a summary of stage-by-stage details
### END OF INSTRUCTIONS ###
